notes:
Summary: Orion Aegis is a global industrial cybersecurity integrator with large government & utilities customers. They need a Private (VPC) offering + an on-prem / air-gapped variant for classified clients. Key asks: full control-plane isolation, HSM-backed KMS, 7+ year immutable audit logs, SAML SSO, EU data residency and FIPS-validated crypto stacks.

What they told us / quoted lines: "Can you guarantee zero egress to public cloud during processing?"; "We require offline patching options — no remote management for pilot systems."

Technical constraints: planned pilot will run in their secure colocation (no internet egress). They expect the Redwood private control plane to be deployable as a customer-managed appliance or thin control plane in a locked VPC with admin console accessible only over a bastion host. HSM/KMS: must support Thales/PKCS#11 and provide ability to import customer keys and attestation. Audit logging: retention policy = 7 years, write-once storage (WORM) preferred; logs must be exportable to their SIEM (Elastic/QRadar).

POC scope (requested): 2-node inference cluster, 1 control-plane appliance (air-gapped), KMS integration test, sample workload (policy-qa + redaction on telemetry docs). SLA ask: 99.9% local uptime for inference nodes; optional managed fallback to Redwood-hosted endpoint for non-classified failover.

Procurement & compliance: Legal flagged indemnity and subprocessors in the DPA; Security wants SOC2/ISO27001 evidence and architecture diagrams for isolated deployment. Their CISO asked for an offline acceptance test plan.

Next steps (internal): deliver architecture deck showing fully disconnected flow, provide HSM integration runbook, propose air-gapped upgrade process, draft DPA redline. SE to validate certificate/cipher suites (FIPS).
